name: Selzee AI Chat
author: selzeeai

sections.description:
Meet Your New AI Salesperson — Online, Nonstop, Zero Fixed Costs

Selzee is not just another chatbot. It’s a trained AI sales assistant that actively sells — watching what your customers browse, recommending the right products, answering questions, and helping complete orders. Just like a skilled salesperson who knows your products and your customers’ needs. Plus, you get a live chat interface included for free.

Trusted by leading e-commerce brands, Selzee is helping online stores increase conversions by up to 7% and average order value by 21%.

Why Choose Selzee?

🛒 Sell More, Automatically: Selzee knows what your visitor is looking at and recommends relevant products at the perfect moment — turning browsers into buyers.

🤖 AI That Actually Works: Handle up to 94% of customer inquiries automatically, without needing a human operator. Your AI salesperson never sleeps.

💬 Live Chat Included Free: Real human conversations when you need them. Live chat comes bundled at no extra cost — manage everything from one dashboard.

📈 Proven Results: Our clients see an average 7% increase in conversions and 21% higher average order value. Real numbers, real growth.

⏰ 24/7 Sales & Support: Works for you during holidays, weekends, flash sales, and midnight shopping sprees. Never miss a sale again.

📊 Insights That Matter: Track performance, recommendations, conversions, AOV, and ROI. Know exactly what’s working and what needs attention.

🔐 Privacy First: Your data stays secure. We take data protection seriously so you can focus on growing your business.

What Can Selzee Do?

Everything you need to transform your customer experience from ordinary to exceptional:

Intelligent Product Recommendations — Selzee watches what visitors browse and suggests products they’re most likely to buy. Like having your best salesperson on every page.

AI Sales Assistant — Automatically answers product questions, handles objections, and guides customers toward purchase. Available 24/7 without breaks.

Multichannel Support — Handles inquiries about products, orders, payments, shipping, and returns — all from one place.

Personalized Conversations — Every customer gets tailored responses based on their behavior. No generic scripts, just relevant help.

Live Chat Integration — When human touch is needed, seamlessly switch to live chat. Included free with every plan.

Simple Setup — Works without touching your code. Full WordPress integration with one-click activation.

Data & Analytics — Comprehensive reporting on performance, recommendations, conversions, and revenue impact.

Who Is Selzee For?

✅ E-commerce stores that want to sell more and handle fewer routine questions
✅ Small teams without extensive customer service resources
✅ Stores with growing traffic or seasonal peaks
✅ Anyone who wants to maximize revenue from existing traffic
✅ Businesses ready for modern AI without the complexity

What Our Users Say

“Selzee transformed how we handle customer inquiries. It recommends products our customers actually want, and our conversion rate jumped noticeably within the first month.”

“We were skeptical about AI chatbots, but Selzee is different — it actually sells. Our average order value increased and our support team finally has time to focus on complex issues.”

“The setup took minutes, not hours. And having live chat included for free? That sealed the deal for us.”

Ready to put an AI salesperson to work on your store? Try Selzee today and see what happens when every visitor gets VIP treatment.

Get started at selzee.com →

License

Selzee AI Chat is distributed under the GPLv2 or later. All bundled assets are owned by Selzee and released under the same license for plugin distribution.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the selzee-ai-chat folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Selzee in your WordPress dashboard menu.
  4. Create your Selzee agent — add a name, photo, choose chat colors, and select a behavior model.
  5. Test your agent with a sample conversation.
  6. Click Add to Website to go live.
  7. Start converting visitors into customers!

For a complete walkthrough, visit your Selzee dashboard after activation.
sections.faq:
How can Selzee benefit my online store?

Selzee actively sells to your visitors by recommending relevant products based on browsing behavior. Our clients see an average 7% increase in conversions and 21% higher average order value. Plus, it handles up to 94% of customer inquiries automatically, freeing your team to focus on high-value tasks.

What’s the cost of Selzee?

The WordPress plugin is free to install. Selzee offers various plans to match your store’s needs, with a free trial period to test everything without commitment. Visit selzee.com for current pricing.

Is live chat included?

Yes! Live chat is included free with Selzee. You can seamlessly switch between AI-powered responses and human conversations whenever needed.

How long does setup take?

Most stores are up and running in under 10 minutes. No coding required — just install, configure your agent, and activate.

Does Selzee work in multiple languages?

Yes, Selzee supports multiple languages. Configure your agent to communicate in the language your customers prefer.

Can I customize how Selzee communicates?

Absolutely. You control the tone of voice, personality, and behavior model. Make Selzee sound exactly like your brand.

Where can I find my chatbot ID?

After creating your agent in the Selzee dashboard, you’ll find your unique chatbot ID in the “Install” or “Settings” panel. Simply copy and paste it into the plugin settings.

Do you have a mobile app?

The Selzee dashboard is fully responsive and works beautifully on mobile devices for both setup and live chat management.

How is Selzee different from other chatbots?

Most chatbots just answer questions. Selzee actively sells — it watches browsing behavior, recommends products, and guides customers toward purchase. It’s the difference between a help desk and a skilled salesperson.
